invariants.observableFact: The Collection experience is presented as a tall cream produce-box panel over a subdued gray background, with rounded corners, a dark hand-drawn outline and shadow, green ribbon treatment, and small leaf accents.
The green title banner reads COLLECTION, followed in order by the variant name, preview, difficulty, availability status, and action area; each section remains visually distinct and readable.
The preview reads as one dense, overlapping produce mass that fills its framed area rather than as isolated thumbnails.
Preview artwork uses the variant's actual sprites, and every visible sprite retains its source aspect ratio and opacity without stretching, squashing, or unintended transparency.
Collection navigation exposes exactly one previous control and one next control, with both controls outside the clipped page content; no BackAction appears in the modal or title banner.
Default supplies the approved composition and visual language, while each variant supplies its own name, difficulty, and sprite artwork; Default-specific content is not copied literally into Pixel.

On the named Xiaomi 23043RP34G review target, the complete modal, both navigation controls, all labels, and the action area remain visible, readable, non-overlapping, and operable without unintended frame-edge clipping.

variants.observableFact: The variant heading reads DEFAULT FRUIT.
Difficulty is represented as level 1 using the approved three-star visual language: one emphasized star and two muted stars.
The Default preview preserves the approved composition of ten representative fruit layers combined into one edge-filling produce mass.
The variant heading reads PIXEL FRUIT.
Difficulty is represented as level 2 using the approved three-star visual language: two emphasized stars and one muted star.

The Pixel preview uses actual Pixel sprites with preserved aspect ratio and opacity while retaining the approved dense produce-box composition; it does not reuse Default artwork as a literal requirement.

states.observableFact: The active set's action reads IN USE, uses active styling, and is non-interactable.
An unlocked selectable set's action reads USE THIS SET, uses visibly selectable styling, and is interactable.
Unlocked availability is communicated separately from the action, with the availability label remaining legible between the difficulty row and action area.
Active and selectable presentations are distinguishable through their exact action labels, styling, and interaction behavior without relying on variant name or artwork.

wholeFrameChecks.observableFact: At full-frame view, the light modal remains clearly separated from the subdued background by its dark contour and shadow, with breathing room around the panel.
At full-frame view, the centered vertical composition remains balanced: the preview is the dominant content region, while the banner, metadata, status, and action retain clear relative hierarchy.
A full-frame capture from the named Xiaomi target shows the entire Collection modal and both navigation directions at once, with no content hidden behind a viewport edge or system obstruction.
A full-frame inspection finds one previous control, one next control, and no BackAction anywhere in the panel or title banner.

The frame consistently uses the approved playful produce-box language: bold uppercase display text, warm paper-like panel, green structural accents, dark illustrated outlines, and orange navigation emphasis.

focusedChecks.observableFact: A focused inspection of the title area shows COLLECTION centered and fully legible on the green ribbon, with no BackAction or unrelated control inside the banner.
A focused inspection of the name and difficulty areas shows the current variant's exact name and numeric difficulty, with no Default metadata leaking into Pixel.
A focused inspection of the Default preview identifies ten representative fruit layers participating in one overlapping produce mass.
A focused inspection of the preview shows actual sprite artwork with intact proportions and opacity, clean clipping at the preview boundary, and no stretched or unintentionally faded fruit.
A focused inspection of the preview edges shows one previous control on one side and one next control on the other, both visually outside the clipped sprite page and not obscured by the produce mass.
A focused inspection of the difficulty row shows a three-star scale whose emphasized-star count equals the current variant's difficulty.

A focused inspection and interaction check of the action area confirms IN USE with no activation for the active state, or USE THIS SET with successful interactability for the unlocked selectable state.
